units.rawText:
To defer to someone else's thinking and judgment... is truly unfamiliar.
To turn into a weapon, to become that person's limbs and tools, and to hit home with every strike.
units.displayText:

spans.text:
To defer to someone else's thinking and judgment... is truly unfamiliar.
To turn into a weapon, to become that person's limbs and tools, and to hit home with every strike.

units.rawText: (So this is what absolute trust feels like...)
units.displayText: So this is what absolute trust feels like...

spans.text: So this is what absolute trust feels like...

units.rawText: (Is this something you've ever felt before?)
units.displayText: Is this something you've ever felt before?

spans.text: Is this something you've ever felt before?

units.rawText: (Is this something I've ever felt before?)
units.displayText: Is this something I've ever felt before?

spans.text: Is this something I've ever felt before?

units.rawText: Whew... Cough, your ammo's dry already, right?
units.displayText: Whew... Cough, your ammo's dry already, right?

spans.text: Whew... Cough, your ammo's dry already, right?

units.rawText: And your gun's in two parts...!
units.displayText: And your gun's in two parts...!

spans.text: And your gun's in two parts...!

units.rawText: You want more? I'm up for a bit of dancing...
units.displayText: You want more? I'm up for a bit of dancing...

spans.text: You want more? I'm up for a bit of dancing...

units.rawText: Block. Right!
units.displayText: Block. Right!

spans.text: Block. Right!

units.rawText: Before Clukay finishes speaking, 416 has already leapt forth. All that is left of the entropized 416 is her battle instinct, and the only one who can judge her movements... is the one most familiar with her.
units.displayText: Before Clukay finishes speaking, 416 has already leapt forth. All that is left of the entropized 416 is her battle instinct, and the only one who can judge her movements... is the one most familiar with her.

spans.text: Before Clukay finishes speaking, 416 has already leapt forth. All that is left of the entropized 416 is her battle instinct, and the only one who can judge her movements... is the one most familiar with her.

units.rawText: We'll see who's the stronger one... You just watch, Commander!
units.displayText: We'll see who's the stronger one... You just watch, Commander!

spans.text: We'll see who's the stronger one... You just watch, Commander!

units.rawText: <color=red>I'm the strongest... without equal! If I kill her, you will... choose me!</color>
units.displayText: I'm the strongest... without equal! If I kill her, you will... choose me!

spans.text: I'm the strongest... without equal! If I kill her, you will... choose me!

units.rawText: What is this lunacy? You're out of control!
units.displayText: What is this lunacy? You're out of control!

spans.text: What is this lunacy? You're out of control!

units.rawText: You didn't even avoid shooting in the Professor's direction in the firefight just then... All you're doing is venting your anger!
units.displayText: You didn't even avoid shooting in the Professor's direction in the firefight just then... All you're doing is venting your anger!

spans.text: You didn't even avoid shooting in the Professor's direction in the firefight just then... All you're doing is venting your anger!

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>Choose me!</color></size>
units.displayText: Choose me!

spans.text: Choose me!

units.rawText: Now, Clukay! To the side—
units.displayText: Now, Clukay! To the side—

spans.text: Now, Clukay! To the side—

units.rawText: Right hand!
units.displayText: Right hand!

spans.text: Right hand!

units.rawText:
In a clash far beyond either's limits, the tide of battle is decided in an instant.
And in the very next moment, the end would come.
units.displayText:
In a clash far beyond either's limits, the tide of battle is decided in an instant.
And in the very next moment, the end would come.

spans.text:
In a clash far beyond either's limits, the tide of battle is decided in an instant.
And in the very next moment, the end would come.

units.rawText: <size=60>—There!</size>
units.displayText: —There!

spans.text: —There!

units.rawText: As Clukay's knife penetrates 416's throat, a sudden metamorphosis takes place. The moment the blade makes contact with 416's skin, the Entropized girl's body ruptures into pieces, proliferating and dividing—
units.displayText: As Clukay's knife penetrates 416's throat, a sudden metamorphosis takes place. The moment the blade makes contact with 416's skin, the Entropized girl's body ruptures into pieces, proliferating and dividing—

spans.text: As Clukay's knife penetrates 416's throat, a sudden metamorphosis takes place. The moment the blade makes contact with 416's skin, the Entropized girl's body ruptures into pieces, proliferating and dividing—

units.rawText: ...A result within expectation, yet beyond any prediction.
units.displayText: ...A result within expectation, yet beyond any prediction.

spans.text: ...A result within expectation, yet beyond any prediction.

units.rawText: They were not quite like fragments of data, but instead countless flowers – not unlike those hairpins she always wears.
units.displayText: They were not quite like fragments of data, but instead countless flowers – not unlike those hairpins she always wears.

spans.text: They were not quite like fragments of data, but instead countless flowers – not unlike those hairpins she always wears.

units.rawText: This was not a finishing strike, but more of a ritual, to commence after the victor had been decided.
units.displayText: This was not a finishing strike, but more of a ritual, to commence after the victor had been decided.

spans.text: This was not a finishing strike, but more of a ritual, to commence after the victor had been decided.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Look at... me...</color>
units.displayText: Look at... me...

spans.text: Look at... me...

units.rawText: 416's fragments, power, memories, all now a storm of purple-blue flowers surrounding Clukay and becoming a part of her.
units.displayText: 416's fragments, power, memories, all now a storm of purple-blue flowers surrounding Clukay and becoming a part of her.

spans.text: 416's fragments, power, memories, all now a storm of purple-blue flowers surrounding Clukay and becoming a part of her.

units.rawText: They are now as one.
units.displayText: They are now as one.

spans.text: They are now as one.
